text:
toni: Opening a tiny PR to tidy the Starter Quicklaunch quickstart. Focus: auth example, single-step first deploy, dependency pins, and two dead links. PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/509
jake: nice. for auth can we standardize on `REDWOOD_KEY` in examples? some SDKs expect that var name now. call it out in a short 'auth vars' note.
renee: yesbut also include the fallback note that older tutorials used `REDWOOD_TOKEN`. learners hit that during workshops.
toni: will add a short Migration note: "OLD_VAR -> NEW_VAR" and a small snippet showing export. keeping the curl example to one line to reduce cognitive load.
docs-bot: preview build queued: https://staging-docs.redwood-inference.dev/pr/509 (ETA ~2m) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jake: for the first-deploy example can we do a single docker run command that sets env and starts the sample? e.g.:
```bash
docker run -e REDWOOD_KEY=$REDWOOD_KEY -p 8080:8080 redwood/sample-hello:0.5.1
```
Keep it pinned to a stable tag and add a note about Dedicated/private installs preferring fixed tags.
toni: pinned tag added and a one-line note about pinning for reproducibility. also removed an old `/getting-started/local` link that 404s and replaced with `/deploy/run-on-local`.
renee: small nit: in the SDK example prefer showing the async snippet first for JS and add a Python minimal one-liner below. some folks search for "async" and expect that.
toni: rearranged examples: curl -> JS async -> Python minimal. trimmed the JS snippet to 6 lines. added a Troubleshooting block for 401/403 and common network issues.
ci-bot: docs lint: passed; link-check: found 1 redirect -> fixed by commit (sha: b8f4c2) :white_check_mark:
jake: could you add a tiny "what to expect" section after running the sample (e.g., "server starts on http://localhost:8080 and returns {\"message\": \"hello\"}") so beginners know it's working?
toni: added expected output and a one-liner health check `curl http://localhost:8080/health`. also updated the sidebar TOC to point directly at the quickstart anchor.
docs-bot: preview updated: https://staging-docs.redwood-inference.dev/pr/509 (status: ready) :rocket:
renee: LGTM. can you squash and add a concise PR description listing changes: auth var rename, pinned image, link fix, order of examples, troubleshooting, expected output?
toni: squashed and pushed. requesting review from @jake @renee. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/509
ci-bot: preview deployment successful for commit (sha: f3d2a1) :white_check_mark:
jake: approved, merging after CI green. thanks for keeping it concise.
toni: merged at 3645008000. thanks all :tada:
